Definition: from G3458; belonging to a mill:--mill(-stone).
BiblicalUsage: Mylikos means belonging to a mill, millstone — it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the millstone is the weight of the warning: harming the little ones is a sin too heavy to carry.
